rust_receipts.reason: Rust immutable transport and lifecycle result receipts, absent in Python.
rust_receipts.returnContract: Python callbacks are compared by first-call row effects; their raw results are reported. Rust entry-point return values are pinned per case. Rust receipt replay alone must return the saved first result with zero total changes; changed content is refused without writes. Python callbacks have no corresponding idempotent receipt contract.

durable_reconciliation_hold.reason: Legacy unknown or paused recovery and generation change retain a named durable hold until native history reconciliation is wired.

token-usage-partials.reason: contextUsage persists; usage-policy/budget-capture, agent-move/cache-capture-not-ported and analytics/token-rate-observation-not-ported are counted.

questions-service/async-question.reason: Questions are counted; pending question/complaint service is outside this slice.

unhandled-notification-kinds.reason: Module-table kinds persist their named counter and receipt; Python service effects are explicitly not compared.

radio-policy.reason: radio_turn is unreachable through scheduler claim (also refuses radioAnswerTurnId); room binding and peer readiness belong to radio service. Plain radio follows Python.

bounded-open-streams.reason: Python has no cap; Rust refuses a new stream at8192 with distinct StreamCapacity and no stored or buffer change, instead of silently dropping text.

context_preparation_unported.reason: Dynamic start-time context is independently captured from Python. Only its appended text and verified derived search postings are projected out of the Python comparison; identity, base input, transcript links, terminal fields and search metadata remain exact. The Rust snapshot is never projected.
